name: Melioristic Egalitarian Artist 1: Help! All of Art Is Trapped Until It Can Be Properly Defined!
storyline: All of art and every artist with it has been trapped within an infinitely looping dimension. The artists trapped in here have one way to free themself and art with them, agree on a definition for art. The main character Sami attempts to bring all of the art together at her gallery so that hopefully the artists can all gather and see the beauty of all forms of art and stop fighting over what counts.
summary:
In the world of Melioristic Egalitarian Artist all of art and every artist with it has been trapped within an infinitely looping dimension that harshly melds together all of art together, the artists trapped in here have one way to free themself and art with them, agree on a definition for art.

Unfortunately for the artists none of them can agree on a definition, some say only their type of artform counts, others say it cannot be defined, and others exclude certain types of art from the conversation.

The main character of this game is Sami, she believes that all art is valuable and if all the artists come together that can work together to save art so Sami decides to open a gallery in order to have a place where all the artists can gather and apricate all the forms of art.

To achieve her goal she must navigate art dimension to gather funds and locate art for the museum while avoiding discarded artworks and used up supplies that line the dimension's floors.
